package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_until_candidate_via_deadline_sub_now: `deadline.Sub(time.Now())` instead of `time.Until(deadline)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario687Positive(deadlines []time.Time) []time.Duration {
	var results []time.Duration
	for _, deadline := range deadlines {
		remaining := deadline.Sub(time.Now())
		results = append(results, remaining)
	}
	return results
}
